This card's maintainer action is bigger than the Root Directory alone. On 2026-10-28 02:14Z, in the card thread, Tesla wrote: 「立一张维护者操作卡，实际没这么简单，因为 vercel 中挂的项目也要改。」 The Vercel-side changes are now tracked on #27030 (`pm:awaiting-maintainer`): Root Directory, the connected Git repository (still the archived objectui repo), build overrides, Node version, env vars, domains and token reach. This card's proof is still the same: a Docs Deploy run on `main` with `deploy-ui-site` green and its deployment URL posted here. Until #27030 is done, a run is expected to go red at the Root Directory step, and that is the pending maintainer action, not a code defect.

Rescoped. This card's goal was for www.objectui.org to serve from the merged repo. It now reaches that goal by redirect instead of a separate deploy.

On 2026-10-28, in this card's thread, Tesla made three calls:
- 03:24Z: chose 「B 并入 objectstack 文档站」.
- 07:58Z: confirmed the page evaluation with 「VS Code 扩展 不会发布，其他同意」.
- 07:58Z: asked for the fold to be dispatched with 「你负责派卡执行」.

The fold is four cards:
- #27140 moves the SDK pages into `content/docs/sdk/`.
- #27141 merges 46 pages into existing objectstack pages.
- #27142 generates the component reference from `sdui.manifest.json`.
- #27145 retires `ui/apps/site` and `ui/content/docs`, drops the `deploy-ui-site` job from #27005, and adds host-based 301s from objectui.org to objectstack.ai/docs.

#27030 is rescoped to the maintainer's domain move plus deleting the `objectui` Vercel project.

This card closes when `https://www.objectui.org/docs/guide/quick-start` answers 301 to its objectstack.ai/docs/sdk page. That happens after #27145 merges and the #27030 domain move. The new close condition replaces the green `deploy-ui-site` run in the Acceptance above. Until #27145 lands, every 6-hourly Docs Deploy run keeps showing that job red at the Root Directory step, which is expected.
